rulings.summary: Bad publicity counters sit on the Corp. When a run's server is announced the Runner fills a bad publicity fund with 1 credit per bad publicity, spendable only during that run, and returns what is left when it ends; taking or removing bad publicity mid-run doesn't change the fund. Either player may remove bad publicity to pay a cost that calls for it.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet fills the fund at run initiation from the Corp's bad publicity count, offers it in run payments and fires a bad-publicity-spent event; take and lose effects use gain-bad-publicity and lose-bad-publicity.

rulings.summary: Credits hosted on a card aren't in a pool; they are spent only as their card allows (during runs, for a kind of cost). A cost payable only with credits from stealth cards may draw on those cards' hosted credits and nothing else.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet tags a payment with a stealth requirement ({:stealth :all-stealth}) and offers only stealth cards' credits; Aircheck adds static cannot-pay-credits-from-pool and cannot-lose-credits effects.

rulings.summary: Abilities can add costs to stealing or scoring an agenda. The Runner may decline a steal cost and leave the agenda; the Corp may not score without paying a score cost.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet models steal costs as steal-additional-cost static abilities (Magistrate Revontulet) and resolves Word on the Street on pre-agenda-scored.

rulings.summary: A card added to a score area 'as an agenda' loses its other properties and gains only the stated agenda points and text; it was neither scored nor stolen.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet uses as-agenda with the printed points (Myōshu 2, Word on the Street -1) and a cannot-forfeit flag where printed.

rulings.summary: A player's score is the sum of the agenda points in their score area, as modified by active abilities; an agenda in the Runner's score area can carry an ability that changes its own value there.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet applies an agenda-value modifier while Let Them Dream is in the Runner's score area.

rulings.summary: Costs are paid in full before effects: trashing a card as a cost, spending an extra click on a Double operation, and cost reductions that apply to a kind of card the first time each turn.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet adds play-additional-cost for Double operations and lowers it for Synchrocyclotron; Sell Out and Methuselah trash as part of their cost.

rulings.summary: Play, install and rez costs can be raised or lowered by abilities and calculated when paid, never below zero.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet applies rez-cost static abilities (Reverb per other unrezzed ice, Hype Machine while an agenda was scored or stolen) and a play-cost reduction for Tailgate.

rulings.summary: Derezzing turns a rezzed card facedown with no cost; ice derezzed while encountered ends that encounter.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet derezzes with derez (Kompromat's choice, realloc(), Knowledge Seeker after its purge).

rulings.summary: The Runner passes a piece of ice when the movement phase moves past it; ice is fully broken when every subroutine was broken in the encounter. Abilities can trigger on either, and on the outermost ice of a server.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet fires pass-ice (Sipa, Vertigo) and subroutines-broken with an all-subs-broken flag (Lethe, The Tungsten Tailor).

rulings.summary: Bypassing ice ends its encounter at once and the Runner passes it; abilities may trigger on the bypass.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet fires bypassed-ice (Lethe).

rulings.summary: Subroutines have an order by how the ice gained them; a subroutine gained for an encounter can come before the printed ones, and only unbroken ones resolve.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet adds additional-subroutines at the front for the encounter (Stick and Poke).

rulings.summary: Jacking out ends the run at once; an effect may offer it as the way to prevent a subroutine.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet resolves Lionsmane's third subroutine as a choice between taking the damage and jacking out.

rulings.summary: A run is declared successful at the success phase; an ability can stop the declaration without making the run unsuccessful.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet blocks it with a block-successful-run static ability (Flagship).

rulings.summary: An ability may cap the cards the Runner accesses during a run on a server; once the cap is reached no further candidate is offered.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet disables access candidacy and random accesses after one other card was accessed (Flagship).

rulings.summary: While accessing a card the Runner may use access abilities and pay trash costs, and some cards must be revealed while accessed in R&D.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet offers Lampades as an access ability paying the accessed card's printed cost from stealth credits; Esca reveals on access in R&D.

rulings.summary: Arranging a deck's top cards repositions them among their own locations, privately, after the player looks at them.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet prompts an arrange order for Cultivate and Knowledge Seeker's subroutine.

rulings.summary: Cards can be hosted facedown on a card without being installed; their controller may look at them, the opponent may not.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet hosts Read-Write Share's cards facedown and shuffles them back with its trash ability.

rulings.summary: Abilities create host relationships: resources installed onto a resource, a program installed on ice, bad publicity counters hosted on an asset. Hosted counters aren't on the player.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet uses can-host and host (Hackerspace, Stowaway) and keeps Luana Campos's hosted bad publicity as counters on the card.

rulings.summary: Paid abilities are used at will in a priority window by paying their trigger cost; some are usable from other zones (Expendable ice from HQ, revealing and trashing itself as part of the cost).
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet implements Expendable as an expend ability usable from HQ with the reveal and trash as its cost (Tocsin).

rulings.summary: A Corp playing Méliès U brings several copies of the identity; the copy in play is chosen secretly and flipped to reveal its side.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet keeps the chosen server on the identity, choosing it at the end of the Corp's turn (the card says its discard phase), flips it on a successful central run and resolves the matching side.

rulings.summary: An interrupt resolves while another instruction is imminent: an asset that is about to be uninstalled acts before it leaves play.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet resolves Luana Campos's bad publicity on its uninstall hook, before the card leaves play.

rulings.summary: Searching a deck looks through it for cards meeting a description and reveals what is found; the deck is shuffled afterwards.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet searches with search and shuffles R&D or the stack after (Editorial Division, Tocsin, Beta Build, Let Them Dream).

rulings.summary: When the Runner breaches Archives, its facedown cards are turned faceup first; abilities can count how many turned faceup at once.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet fires archives-flipped with the count (Nurse Hạnh).

rulings.summary: Conditional abilities trigger on game events (turn and phase steps, scoring, advancing, runs) and may check turn facts such as an agenda scored this turn or ice rezzed this turn.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet uses turn events (corp-action-phase-ends, runner-action-phase-ends) and per-turn registers for scored, installed and rezzed facts.

rulings.summary: Tags are removed as an effect or as a cost; cards can count the Runner's tags.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet removes tags as an additional cost (Unleash) and counts them for Vicsek's X.

rulings.summary: A persistent ability stays active through the access on which its card is trashed, for the rest of that run.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet re-registers Flagship's access limits as lingering effects when it is trashed during the run.

rulings.summary: Net and meat damage trash cards from the grip at random; damage greater than the grip flatlines the Runner.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet deals damage with damage (Esca, Lionsmane, Vicsek, Shackleton Grid).

rulings.summary: Installing can come from other zones (Archives, the stack), be followed by a rez paying less, or be restricted (only on ice, only faceup).
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet installs from Archives and rezzes paying less (Reanimation Protocol, Retirement Plan), hosts trojans on ice and installs Public agendas faceup.

rulings.summary: Swapping exchanges two cards' positions; swapped ice keeps its rezzed state.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet uses swap-ice (ezaM, Sipa).

rulings.summary: Clicks are gained, lost and allotted; an effect can change a player's allotted clicks for their next turn.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet adjusts the Runner's next-turn allotment for Caveat Emptor and spends a click as Méliès City Luxury Line's steal cost.

rulings.summary: Counters of several kinds sit on cards: power counters, agenda counters, and virus counters, which ice can also host and a purge removes.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet places virus counters on Knowledge Seeker and purges them when the encounter ends with 3 or more.
